display_long_description:
Gorilla HELL is a hand-based locomotion horror experience that throws you into a dark and unsettling world where every corner hides a new mystery. Inspired by the movement style that players know and love, this game combines fast-paced exploration with an atmosphere designed to keep you on edge. Navigate eerie environments, uncover secrets hidden throughout the map, and experience moments that blur the line between curiosity and fear.

Whether you're looking to casually explore the world, hang out with friends, test your movement skills, or challenge yourself against the horrors that lurk in the darkness, Gorilla HELL offers something for every type of player. From abandoned locations and unsettling sounds to unexpected encounters and hidden lore, the game is built around creating memorable experiences that can be both fun and terrifying.

Explore at your own pace, search for secrets, experiment with the mechanics, and discover everything the world has to offer. Some areas may seem safe, while others may leave you questioning what is waiting just out of sight. Keep moving, stay alert, and remember that not everything in Gorilla HELL is what it seems.
